+def add_db_name(rec: dict) -> None:
+    """Add a comparable ``db_name`` to each author in ``rec`` in place."""
+    authors = rec.get('authors')
+    if not isinstance(authors, list):
+        return
+
+    for author in authors:
+        if not isinstance(author, dict):
+            continue
+        name = author.get('name') or ''
+        date = author.get('date')
+        if date is None or date == '':
+            birth_date = author.get('birth_date') or ''
+            death_date = author.get('death_date') or ''
+            if birth_date or death_date:
+                date = f'{birth_date}-{death_date}'
+            else:
+                date = None
+        author['db_name'] = ' '.join(str(value) for value in (name, date) if value)
+
+
+def _record_names(value):
+    """Return copied name records, tolerating absent or malformed values."""
+    if not isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
+        return []
+    return [dict(item) for item in value if isinstance(item, dict)]
+
+
+def _isbn_values(value):
+    if value is None:
+        return []
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return [value] if value else []
+    try:
+        return [isbn for isbn in value if isbn is not None and isbn != '']
+    except TypeError:
+        return [value]
+
+
+def expand_record(rec: dict) -> dict:
+    """Build a normalized, comparable representation of an edition record."""
+    title = rec.get('title')
+    if not isinstance(title, str) or not title:
+        title = rec.get('full_title') or ''
+    title = str(title)
+    if rec.get('title') and rec.get('title_prefix'):
+        prefix = str(rec['title_prefix'])
+        title = prefix + ('' if prefix.endswith(' ') else ' ') + title
+    subtitle = rec.get('subtitle')
+    if isinstance(subtitle, str) and subtitle:
+        title = f'{title} {subtitle}'.strip()
+
+    expanded = build_titles(title)
+    # Preserve any variants provided by a previously expanded record.
+    variants = rec.get('titles')
+    if not isinstance(variants, (list, tuple, set)):
+        variants = []
+    for variant in variants:
+        if isinstance(variant, str) and variant not in expanded['titles']:
+            expanded['titles'].append(variant)
+
+    expanded['isbn'] = []
+    for field in ('isbn', 'isbn_10', 'isbn_13'):
+        for isbn in _isbn_values(rec.get(field)):
+            if isbn not in expanded['isbn']:
+                expanded['isbn'].append(isbn)
+
+    country = rec.get('publish_country')
+    if country not in (None, '', '   ', '|||'):
+        expanded['publish_country'] = country
+
+    for field in (
+        'lccn',
+        'publishers',
+        'publish_date',
+        'number_of_pages',
+    ):
+        if field in rec and rec[field] is not None:
+            expanded[field] = rec[field]
+
+    for field in ('authors', 'contribs'):
+        if field in rec:
+            expanded[field] = _record_names(rec[field])
+            existing_db_names = [author.get('db_name') for author in expanded[field]]
+            # Contributor names are compared by the same rules as author names.
+            add_db_name({'authors': expanded[field]})
+            for author, db_name in zip(expanded[field], existing_db_names):
+                if db_name:
+                    author['db_name'] = db_name
+    return expanded
+
